title.zh: 计算并测量注意力的代价
title.en: Compute and measure the cost of attention

prompt.zh: 写出一层中各部分的乘法次数、线性项与平方项相等时的长度，以及注意力矩阵占用的显存。再实现一个对数坐标下的斜率拟合，用它从实测时间里估计注意力耗时随长度增长的幂次。
prompt.en: Write the number of multiplications of each part of a layer, the length at which the linear and quadratic terms are equal, and the memory taken by the attention matrices. Then implement a slope fit in log coordinates and use it to estimate from measured times the power with which attention time grows with length.

hints.zh: 拟合斜率时先对 `xs` 和 `ys` 取 `math.log`，再套一元线性回归的斜率公式。
hints.en: For the slope take `math.log` of `xs` and `ys` first and apply the slope formula of simple linear regression.
